text: Over the six matched e <= 0.5 seeds so far, the half-final-margin delay (N=256 minus N=64) is never below +10 (+20/+10/+30/+30/+10/+30), while the 0.1-bar delay ranges from 0 to +70. Is the half-final measure the more stable timing statistic? Is the 0.1-bar spread driven mainly by per-seed control R2 (for example seed 57's 0.778)?
